Strategy: Use the most common size. Prefer the bin whose residual value appears most often among open bins, since that size is the most replaceable, and break ties toward the tightest leftover. Score by duplicate count times the item size minus the leftover, so ranking can switch from Best Fit to a duplicated size. It may help by preserving rare sizes, but may fail by chasing common sizes that future items never need.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [sum([1 for s in bins if s == r]) * item - (r - item) for r in bins]
```
